teach_overlay.scale: an aquaporin channel is like a stadium turnstile exactly one water molecule wide — three billion water molecules sprint through in single file every second, but at the midpoint two electric magnets spin each water molecule halfway round so acid protons trying to hop along the line are stopped cold
